approved_exceptions.scope: One fixed, developer-authored, compiled Book in development and test only.
preconditions: Constrain and contract-test the public mount macro to literal module alias/reference AST forms; keep its contract test and implementation in separate PRs per ADR 0021.
Before Book implementation, pass positive production route/story-beam exclusion checks and a negative control that rejects any reachable production mount.
excludes: Any follow-on milestone without a fresh scope and prerequisite review
